name: 'Basil' (Michael Seed; anonymous silhouette, Hatton Garden reconstruction)
depiction: Always drawn as an anonymous rim-lit silhouette: no face, not a likeness. Represents the man known as 'Basil', who got the gang into the building; he was identified, convicted in 2019 and is referred to only by that nickname on screen.
rules: Silhouette only (silhouette: 'cool' or 'warm'). Never shown with a face.
